name: Aliaksandr Zhebit
summary: Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience in frontend and full-stack development. Experienced in building enterprise web applications, dashboards, ERP/CRM workflows, and internal automation tools. Skilled in designing user-facing workflows, improving complex UI systems, and working across frontend, backend, databases, and integrations.

sourceability.name: Sourceability
sourceability.stack: Angular 17-19, PrimeNG, ChartJS, .NET 8-10, ASP.NET Core, EF Core, SQL Server, RabbitMQ, SignalR, Python, Docker
contributions: Implemented the majority of global UI features, interactive dashboards, reporting charts, reusable components, and state management systems.
Led frontend development for the Zollner analytics sub-project from PRD to production, delivering dedicated Shortage and PPV workflows with full audit trail support.

Developed robust backend logic, delivering complex KPI calculations, reporting APIs, and automated background services integrated with multiple external systems for cross-platform data synchronization.
Resolved performance bottlenecks across Angular rendering layers, API response times, and database queries.
Enhanced Azure CI/CD pipelines with automated Angular UI testing steps to streamline the validation process.
Resolved complex production issues end-to-end across the entire application stack to maintain system stability and performance.
Expanded internal AI-assisted ecosystem tools by adding specialized workflow capabilities to a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Azure DevOps.
Investigated agentic workflow frameworks, local LLM execution, and Docker-based automation pipelines for an internal web application generation prototype.
Conducted UI technical interviews, facilitated onboarding processes, and provided technical assistance to development and QA teammates.
sourceability.description: Developed features and supported production releases across both frontend and backend layers for a global enterprise supply chain and ERP/CRM ecosystem handling electronic components distribution, RFQ workflows, and warehouse operations, alongside its analytics sub-project, Zollner.

ey.name: Ernst & Young (EY) Raptor

ey.description: Coordinated frontend development and full-stack feature delivery for the EY Global Tax Platform (GTP), a secure cloud environment integrating disparate data sources for global analytics, compliance, and tax visibility.
